description: This file defines the TbGeoMap class, a specialized map component for the Thingsboard platform, utilizing Leaflet for map rendering and handling various geographic data transformations and map controls.

classes.name: TbGeoMap
classes.description: A map component extending TbMap, providing geographic data handling, map control setup, and layer management for Thingsboard.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the TbGeoMap with context, settings, and container element.

methods.name: createMap
methods.description: Creates and initializes the Leaflet map instance with specified settings.

methods.name: fitBounds
methods.description: Adjusts the map view to fit given bounds with zoom and center logic.

methods.name: doSetupControls
methods.description: Loads and sets up map layers and controls.

methods.name: loadLayers
methods.description: Loads map layers based on settings.

methods.name: locationDataToLatLng
methods.description: Converts location data to Leaflet LatLng.

methods.name: latLngToLocationData
methods.description: Converts Leaflet LatLng to location data.

methods.name: polygonDataToCoordinates
methods.description: Transforms raw polygon data into coordinate arrays.

methods.name: coordinatesToPolygonData
methods.description: Converts coordinate arrays into polygon data.

methods.name: circleDataToCoordinates
methods.description: Transforms circle data into coordinate form.

methods.name: polylineDataToCoordinates
methods.description: Transforms raw polyline data into coordinate arrays.

methods.name: coordinatesToPolylineData
methods.description: Converts coordinate arrays into polyline data.
